p: The free version of the App includes 60 minutes of viewing every day; this time renews daily. The optional CineStream PRO removes this daily limit. PRO plans: Monthly subscription ₺80, Yearly subscription ₺800 and a one-time Lifetime plan ₺1500 (prices in Türkiye). The current price is shown on the Google Play screen before purchase and may vary by country.
list: All payments are processed by Google Play Billing; your card details never reach us.

Monthly and yearly subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each period unless you cancel. You can cancel in Google Play > Payments & subscriptions; after cancelling, PRO continues until the end of the paid period.
The Lifetime plan is a one-time payment and does not renew.
PRO is linked to the Google account used for the purchase. It can be activated on your other devices that use the same Google account with "Restore purchases".
Refund requests are subject to Google Play's refund policy and applicable consumer law.
